en-US.title: Unlock PDF
en-US.subtitle: Remove PDF passwords offline
en-US.description:
Unlock PDF removes the password from protected PDF files - entirely on your iPhone.

Pick a locked PDF, enter its password once, and save or share an unlocked copy that opens anywhere without a password prompt.

WHY UNLOCK PDF

- 100% offline: your files and passwords never leave your device
- No accounts, no subscriptions, no ads
- Fast: unlocks most documents in under a second
- Works with the Files app, iCloud Drive, and any document provider
- Share or save the unlocked copy anywhere with the share sheet
- Native iOS design with full dark mode support

PRIVACY FIRST

Unlike online PDF unlockers, Unlock PDF does all processing locally. Nothing is uploaded, tracked, or collected. The app works in airplane mode.

Note: you need to know the password of the PDF - this app removes the password protection from documents you can already open, it does not crack or bypass unknown passwords.

review.notes: The app removes password protection from PDF files locally on device. To test: tap 'Choose a PDF', select any password-protected PDF, enter its password, tap 'Unlock PDF'. No account or network connection is needed.
